samples.question: A leftmost panel shows the initial stack: a vertical column of coloured discs sitting on a base line, read bottom to top, with the top (highest) disc marked by an orange ring. To the right are four operator panels, read left to right. A PUSH panel shows a coloured disc above a matching upward arrow and places that colour onto the top of the stack; a POP panel shows a dark downward arrow over an empty slot and removes the current top disc, revealing the colour below it. The final stack is not drawn anywhere; replay the operators in order from the initial stack. What colour is on top of the final stack? Answer 'red', 'green', 'blue', or 'empty' (if every disc was popped).
